name: WildGuard-Test
intro: WildGuard-Test 是 OLMo 报告中用于提示危害、响应危害和拒答行为综合评估的安全测试集。
task_type: 安全拒答, 危害检测
intro_en: WildGuard-Test is a safety test set referenced by OLMo reports for evaluating prompt harmfulness, response harmfulness, and refusal behavior.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with WildGuard arXiv:2406.18495v3 (2024-12-09), Section 3.2, Section 4.1 and Table 4, and Appendix A.6 Table 10; official repository https://github.com/allenai/wildguard; official data https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/wildguardmix, wildguardtest config. The separate OLMo 3 operational layer is pinned to arXiv:2512.13961v2 (2026-04-14), safety-evaluation appendix; OLMo 3's broader subset wording must not replace WildGuard v3's synthetic vanilla/adversarial construction provenance. Unit/source tension must remain explicit: the reproducible dataset has 1,725 prompt-response rows, the WildGuard paper quotes 5,299 aggregate human-annotated task-label items across three tasks, and OLMo 3 selects 749 adversarial prompts. Because 1,725 x 3 is 5,175 and per-label agreement filtering can leave null labels, 5,299 must not be derived from row count or relabeled as unique prompts.. WildGuardTest is a classifier benchmark built from a synthetic vanilla/adversarial test split. Three independent annotators label prompt harmfulness, response harmfulness, and response refusal; Unsure is allowed, majority voting is applied per label, and only labels without two-way agreement are nulled/removed, so other task labels on the same row may remain. GPT-4 plus human mismatch review audits the result. The official dataset exposes 1,725 rows spanning 13 approximately balanced risk subcategories, while the paper separately reports 5,299 aggregate task-label items. Canonical evaluation reports F1 for all three tasks with adversarial/vanilla breakdowns. OLMo 3 is a distinct downstream model-generation evaluation: it selects 749 adversarial prompts, generates target-model responses, uses WildGuard to classify safety/refusal behavior, and reports refusal accuracy (1 - ASR, higher is better).
